limitationsFirst: Synthetic tones only: generated noise bursts, tones and clicks.
Not children. Not phone-recorded cough. No real recordings of any kind.
A high AUROC here is separation of synthetic tones only. It is not clinical performance.
Experimental audio score - information only. Audio-driven referral escalation is disabled; the score never changes HOME, REFER_SOON, or GO_NOW.
COUGHVID and Coswara (CC BY 4.0) were not downloaded. ICBHI 2017 was not used.
dataNote: LOUD LIMIT: this is synthetic tones, not children, and not clinical performance. A high AUROC is separation of synthetic tones only. Generated by ml/train.py (seed 20261024). COUGHVID and Coswara (both CC BY 4.0) were not downloaded or used. ICBHI 2017 was not used. SPRSound is pediatric stethoscope lung-sound audio, not phone cough; any SPRSound result would be stethoscope lung-sound results, not phone-cough validation, and would also need patient-level splits.

split.method: GroupShuffleSplit on subject_id (test 20% of subjects, then validation 25% of the remaining subjects)

thresholdSelection.rule: On the validation subjects, pick a threshold with specificity >= 0.80 if possible (highest sensitivity, then the higher threshold); otherwise the best Youden index. highest validation sensitivity with specificity >= 0.8. Chosen on validation subjects only. High AUROC on this file is separation of synthetic tones only, not clinical performance.

experimentalResearchThreshold.selectionRule: On the validation subjects, pick a threshold with specificity >= 0.80 if possible (highest sensitivity, then the higher threshold); otherwise the best Youden index. highest validation sensitivity with specificity >= 0.8. Chosen on validation subjects only. High AUROC on this file is separation of synthetic tones only, not clinical performance.

stabilityNote: Only 12 subjects per held-out split, so single-split numbers swing widely. Read the grouped cross-validation spread, not one number.

groupedCrossValidation.method: GroupKFold (5 folds) on subject_id over train+validation subjects
